name: visualneedle_300en
description: VisualNeedle 300 (EN) is a visual needle-in-haystack benchmark for vision-language models. Each of the 300 samples poses a question about a tiny region (median ~0.1% of image area) in a relatively large photograph, and the model must locate and reason over that region to produce the correct answer. Tasks span five categories: Color Recognition, OCR Recognition, Entity Recognition, Spatial Relationship, and Occluded Object Recognition.

distribution.name: annotations.jsonl
distribution.description: JSON Lines file with 300 annotated samples; one JSON object per line.

distribution.name: images_bbox
distribution.description: Same images with the answer bounding box drawn in red, for visualization.

field.name: category
field.description: Task category. One of: Color Recognition, OCR Recognition, Entity Recognition, Spatial Relationship, Occluded Object Recognition.

field.name: answer
field.description: Ground-truth answer; may be English or Chinese (when the answer is text rendered in the image).

field.name: image_path
field.description: Relative path to the original image file within the dataset, e.g. 'images/<id>.jpg'.

field.name: image_url
field.description: Public URL of the original image.

field.name: image_bbox_path
field.description: Relative path to the bbox-annotated image file within the dataset, e.g. 'images_bbox/<id>.jpg'.

field.name: image_bbox_url
field.description: Public URL of the same image with the answer bounding box drawn (for sanity check / visualization).

field.name: bbox
field.description: Answer bounding box in xyxy absolute pixel coordinates: [x1, y1, x2, y2]. Origin is the top-left of the original image.

rai:dataCollection: Images were collected from real-world photographs across diverse scenes (street markets, retail interiors, signage, household objects). Each image was paired with a question about a small region whose answer is verifiable from the pixels alone. Each sample was manually annotated with a tight bounding box around the answer region.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Human annotators wrote the question, ground-truth answer, and a tight xyxy bounding box for the answer region. A second pass verified that the answer is uniquely determinable from the bounded region.
rai:dataLimitations: Small benchmark size (300 samples); statistical comparisons across models require care.
Five fixed task categories may not cover all needle-in-haystack failure modes.
Answers may include Chinese characters (for OCR tasks reading text in the image), which can be biased against models with weaker multilingual OCR.
rai:dataBiases: Image domain skew: many scenes are urban/East-Asian (street food, signage), which may not be representative of all geographies.
OCR samples are weighted toward Chinese text in real-world photographs.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Some images may incidentally contain bystander faces or license plates. The dataset was not curated to remove such content; users should not use it to train models that target individuals.
rai:dataUseCases: Evaluating vision-language model performance on fine-grained, small-region perception.
Benchmarking robustness to high-resolution / cluttered scenes.
Diagnosing failure modes (color, OCR, entity, spatial, occlusion) separately.
rai:dataSocialImpact: Intended for evaluation only; not for training. Improvements on this benchmark could lead to better assistive vision models, but the same capability could be used for invasive surveillance — users are advised to follow responsible-use practices.
rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Hosted on Tencent COS at the URL above. Errata, if any, will be released as a versioned update (v1.0.0 → v1.0.1, etc.) at the same URL prefix.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Images stored at original resolution (no resizing).
Bounding boxes stored in xyxy absolute pixel coordinates relative to the original image.
One bounding box was clamped from [-1, 1164, 45, 1230] to [0, 1164, 45, 1230] to stay inside image bounds.
